question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**necessities**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the various aspects that are essential for a comfortable living environment.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate something that is essential or required.
 
• "**Necessities**" (आवश्यकताएं) fits well as it denotes essential items required for living, which aligns with the context of the passage.
 
• Other options ("**identities**", "**facilities**", "**amenities**") do not fit the context of describing essential items for living.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Identities (पहचान):** "Identities" means the characteristics determining who or what a person or thing is.
 
• **Facilities (सुविधाएं):** "Facilities" means buildings, services, or equipment.
 
• **Amenities (सुविधाएं):** "Amenities" means desirable or useful features or facilities.
